notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Dear space western aficionados, after another month of hard work we're proud to bring you a whole new update to Exoplanet: First Contact!

In this update we've concentrated on adding new quests which use new features of our questing system as well as updating old quests to use these features. What it means for you, dear players, is that it will make it easier (and faster!) for us to extend and modify existing quests when new features, characters and locations are added! We have also added the first prototype of the map! You can buy it from some of the trader characters in the game (yes, you have to possess a map first to use it).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028179/b1a57300ed1eaa436fc2ac5a9092cb06ddcc2831.png[/img]

[*][b][b]SOME OF THE MOST NOTEWORTHY CHANGES OF THIS UPDATE:[/b][/b]

[b]WORLD[/b]

[*]airducts explorable by rc bugs
[*]lots of minor edits and polishing

[b]VISUALS[/b]

[*]changed the old slow death animation of abori bandits to random knockdown animation
[*]more abori heads variations
[*]added bandage meshes to abori and bandaged Swift Strider
[*]added proper item model for Vasily tools
[*]added wounded aborigine worker styles

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028179/41e065a044bda52c444d48df8ee340b5e22a4ba3.jpg[/img]

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

[*]traders can have different selling and buying prices
[*]you can now choose which attributes are to upgrade each level! Level ups earn you attribute points which you can spend in stats window ('C' button)
[*]stamina regenerates faster when standing still or walking
[*]added height limits to object focus syste
[*]some doors can now be unlocked with a special code

[b]ITEMS[/b]

[*]added first energy weapon! (reward for one of the new quests)
[*]added smoking
[*]added medium bounty hunter armor with icons to Eli's trade list
[*]armored duster and heavy bounty hunter armor cost more
[*]heavy bounty hunter has more armor
[*]added hats descriptions
[*]new models and icons for journals and books
[*]updated icons for some items

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028179/b65936fd3281aea8a73533c767cbc6bef9c42fb9.png[/img]

[b]UI[/b]

[*]added zoomable map (item and functionality)
[*]new crafting window
[*]added inventory tabs
[*]faster dialog scroll
[*]fixed stat notifications popping up in dialog
[*]added a warning dialog that shows up when trying to load an older save
[*]crosshair turns red when there is a hostile entity under it
[*]keypad window for locked doors

[b]QUESTS / DIALOGS[/b]

[*]added three new quests: one at Hunter's Rest and two at the Fort
[*]reworked existing quests, related dialogs and journal logs
[*]Vasily asks for any kind of booze the first time, and any strong booze for the new quest
[*]certain dialog topics are now colored grey to indicate that the player already discussed these topics with an NPC
[*]added ambient subtitles to Swift Strider

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028179/ae986c971fcfb110ffc4c083de6247d6be7223df.jpg[/img]

[b]OTHER[/b]

[*]minor loading time optimization
[*]added falling animation to all jumps
[*]enabled sky and weather loading
[*]added left/right/back sounds to human_male.events

[b]FIXES[/b]

[*]a very nasty bug which tended to appear at random was finally squashed
[*]fixed scanwave broken sound playing on hitting Q while secondary inventories are open
[*]unblocked stats button while resting
[*]added quest log update upon finding vasily's toolbox
[*]added a small check that creates a new log if you already have Vasily's tools
[*]fixed cursor not appearing on fast travel. Fixed a couple of similar issues with other windows
[*]fixed broken E button in remote bug control
[*]fixed a bug that occured when leaving bed early
[*]fixed unlimited experience from reading items
[*]fixed a typo in Wet Work description
[*]fixed important loading bug with permanent buffs
[*]fixed not being able to stop bug control
[*]fixed turret tracking the rc bug
[*]increased fade-in speed of fast travel cause low fps slows fading. Adjusted timings
[*]fixed some Crucasses and Hornhogs dealing no damage after loading
[*]fixed killed enemies from damage over time effects not giving experience
[*]lots of other fixes and additions


As usual, we recommend to start a new game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/531660

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hey, guys! We're very excited to bring you this new update with bandit enemies, reloadable guns and much, much more!

We would like to thank all of you for continuing support and feedback! That is really important to us. Each update gets us closer to the final goal and we are really happy to have you on-board.

    [*]Here is an overview of the features we've added to this update:

[b]WORLD[/b]

    [*]Enemy bandits. They will attack the hero on sight
    [*]Two Bounty Hunter Terminals: near Hunter's Rest and in the Fort
    [*]The Fort has been expanded and updated in preparation for future quests

    [*]added 3 new aboriginal melee weapons

    [*]mining mechanics have been rebalanced, players with low mining skill should miss less often

    [*]dialogs now have a dedicated Trade button
    [*]reworked trading window, should be cleaner now
    [*]certain objects far below or far above the player should no longer be focused on
    [*]removed unnecessary horizontal scrollbar in the inventory
    [*]bigger journal fonts, easier to read
    [*]equipped items are now marked in the inventory and shown at the top

[b]OPTIONS[/b]

    [*]added [u]shadow map resolution slider[/u] (choose the details of the game's shadows)
    [*]added texture LOD bias slider. It can be used to make distant textures sharper

[b]QUESTS / DIALOGS[/b]

    [*]added a new bandit bounty hunt quest (check terminals or quest giver Castor in the fort)
    [*]added a dialog and a little quest for Mister Green
    [*]added a new trader in the fort
    [*]added a new trader and teacher (Old Mug)
    [*]a couple of new dialogs for the new NPCs (caravaneers)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028179/a288fac884bd14a513e0570f0840005a791f066d.jpg[/img]

    [*]certain objects when activated now should show tooltips if they require items you lacks

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hey gang, we're hard at work on our first content update right now, and despite the holidays we have managed to bring you yet another hotfix update with lots of fixes and improvements.

Here is the list of some of the most noteworthy changes:

Visuals
[olist]
[*]added hard landing animation as well as landing animations variations when player holds a pistol or a shotgun
[*]limited the extent to which various character can turn their head to look at someone
[/olist]

Gameplay
[olist]
[*]faster swimming when holding shift
[*]fixed bug when Jack would rarely freeze and stop responding to keyboard input if he ate or drink something in rapid succession
[/olist]

Save/Load
[olist]
[*]autosave before sitting at a campfire
[*]autosave on quest finish
[/olist]

UI
[olist]
[*]added an enemy healthbar and label at the top of the screen that is currently under attack of the player
[*]can now clear any hotbar slot by right clicking and selecting "clear slot" option
[*]empty containers are now labeled as such
[*]the player can now drag an item to a hotbar straight from a container
[*]the hunger/thirst notifications should show up once every 30 seconds
[/olist]

Quests/Dialogs
[olist]
[*]green bug quest: added a visual placeholder so it is now clear where the bait must be placed once the player found the right cluster of bitebug hives
[*]it is no longer required for the player to "install" the bait for the greenbug from the inventory
[*]the green bug is a quest item, so it doesn't matter how many regular bugs the player has in his inventory
[*]it is now possible to return Zak's whistle to Zak
[*]talking with Juggo immediately after he says he's going to start digging but before he actually starts moving should no longer result in Juggo being stuck
[/olist]

We recommend to start a new game. However, if you didn't yet start the green bug quest, loading an old save might just work.

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Dear players, here is yet another hotfix update with lots of fixes and improvements.

The list of changes includes but not limited to:

Visuals
[olist]
[*]Correct sprint animation with two-handed ranged weapons e.g. shotguns added
[*]Added a landing animation after a jump
[*]Eating melons should show the melon in Jack's hand
[/olist]

Gameplay
[olist]
[*]A small introductory scene at the beginning of the level added
[*]You can light up dead campfires
[*]Fixed a bug when you could eat  more food without waiting till the eating animation finishes
[*]Scanner is now an item, you must have it in your inventory in order to be able to scan your surroundings
[/olist]

Balance
[olist]
[*]NPC Msasi buys hornhog horns for a good price
[*]Harvestable plants now regrow their fruits at a slower pace
[*]Increased maximum height at which falling damages Jack - you can now land from higher places safely
[/olist]

Save/Load
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug with invisible objects after loading
[/olist]

Input
[olist]
[*]You are no longer forced to walk after depleting your stamina
[/olist]

UI
[olist]
[*]You can select a screen resolution in options
[*]Fullscreen mode added to options
[*]Loading screen tells how Jack ended up on K'Tharsis
[*]Fast travel now has its own ui
[*]Item value will be displayed in tooltip
[*]Increased number of inventory slots to 100
[*]Completed quests now should be greyed out in journal
[*]Escape button closes waiting menu, forces exit from terminal and returns back to pause menu from options and save/load menus
[/olist]

Quests/Dialogs
[olist]
[*]A couple of Jack's phrases are voiced now
[*]Fixed a bug when you could talk with Juggo about the arphant while Molly was already on the way to Zak
[*]The player could activate the lost arphant's quest completion condition instead of Molly
[*]Added a quest to fix your scanner
[/olist]

Other
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug with skipped notifications
[*]Lots of typos fixed
[/olist]

As always, we recommend you to start a new game. You might try loading an old save, but this way you might skip some content you might be interested in.

----------------------------------
Дорогие игроки!
Ниже представлен список большинства изменений и улучшений которые мы сделали за последнее время:

Визуальные
[olist]
[*]Исправлена анимация спринта с двуручными оружием (дробовик и др)
[*]Добавлена анимация приземления после прыжка
[*]В руках джека будет отображаться еда когда он ест продукты
[/olist]

Игровые
[olist]
[*]Добавлена небольшая вступительная сцена с озвучкой после загрузки новой игры
[*]Добавлена возможность зажигать потухшие костры
[*]Исправлена проблема когда можно было начать есть еду до того как Джек завершил употреблять текущую
[*]Сканер теперь является обычным предметом который находится в инвентаре
[/olist]

Баланс
[olist]
[*]NPC Msasi покупает рог кабарога по хорошей цене
[*]Собираемые растения теперь дольше растут
[*]Увеличена высота с которой персонаж может спрыгнуть не получив повреждений
[/olist]

Сохранение/Загрузка
[olist]
[*]Исправлена проблема с некоторыми объектами которые могли становиться невидимыми после загрузки сохранения
[/olist]

Управление
[olist]
[*]После истощения стамины персонаж не переходит автоматом на ходьбу
[/olist]

Интерфейс
[olist]
[*]Добавилась опция выбора разерешения
[*]Добавилась опция полноэкранного режима
[*]Во время загрузки Джек рассказывает как он оказался на планете K'Tharsis
[*]Интефейс Фаст тревел пунктов переработан
[*]Стоимость предметов теперь показывается в окошке с доп. информацией
[*]Количество ячеек инвентаря увеличено до 100
[*]Завершенные квесты в журнале теперь отображаются серым цветом
[*]Кнопка Escape теперь закрывает меню ожидания у костра, инициирет выход из режима терминала, и позволяет выйти из подменю опций и др. обратно в меню паузы
[/olist]

Квесты/Диалоги
[olist]
[*]Добавлена озвучка некоторых фраз Джеком
[*]Исправлен баг когда все еще можно было поговорить с Juggo об арфанте после его возвращения хозяину
[*]Игрок мог завершить квест "Потеряный арфант" в обход возвращения  Molly
[*]Добавлен квест для починки сканнера
[/olist]

Другое
[olist]
[*]Исправлен баг с пропавшим уведомлением о достижении лимита инвентаря живыми жуками
[*]Опечатки
[/olist]

Как обычно, мы рекомендуем начать новую игру. Но можете попробовать загрузить уже сохраненную однако вы можете пропустить новый контент.

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Dear space cowboys, we've been hard at work this whole week fixing bugs and making the game more enjoyable.

The list of changes includes but not limited to:

Optimization
[olist]
[*]game’s performance improved on 20-30% depending on your PC configuration.
[/olist]

Gameplay
[olist]
[*]fixed a bug where stamina and energy would recover faster with lower framerate
[*]increased inventory space
[*]you can now choose how many items to sell an item
[*]while walking as a bug you no longer see interact hints
[*]if empty-handed, clicking Left Mouse Button now should draw the last equipped weapon
[*]fixed the shock fence recipe: it needs a tripod, electrical and mechanical scrap to craft
[*]added eating animations for Jack
[*]you can now cook more than one item at once at the campfire
[*]bluethorn now has harvestable branches with leaves growing over time (like desert melons and other plants)
[*]added sound effects to running arphants
[/olist]

Balance
[olist]
[*]increased SCAMP and The Equalizer damage, decreased cactus club and LED lamp damage
[*]hornhogs shouldn't be so easy to stunlock and kill from behind anymore
[*]significantly reduced kilocalories decrease from sprinting
[*]using Jack’s scanner implant costs more energy
[/olist]

Save/Load
[olist]
[*]loading should no longer put random objects from the inventory on Jack's back
[*]saving and loading now should properly handle permanent buffs, hunger, hydration
[*]if the the main character dies, autosave no longer triggers on exit to menu
[*]save button is turned off when the main character is dead
a couple of seconds after Jack’s death a dialog box will pop up asking if you [*]want to load a saved game. Selecting Yes would open a list of saved games, otherwise you will quit to the main menu.
[*]shock fences, sunflower beacons and turrets are properly saved and loaded now
[/olist]

Input
[olist]
[*]you can now adjust camera height with Page Up\Down buttons
[*]added a journal entry that keeps track of all discovered fast travel destinations
[*]added menu options for inverting mouse Y axis, field of view adjustment slider and mouse sensitivity settings
[/olist]

UI
[olist]
[*]hitting Escape now will close game’s GUI windows such as inventory etc
[*]added an entry in Help screen about some cool things you can do with a captured living bug
[*]fixed a bug where you couldn't drag and drop items from various containers to your inventory
[*]item info texts should no longer be cutoff by the top of the screen
[*]notifications stay longer on the screen
[*]hotbar should now show item count if more than one is available in your inventory
[*]date alignment in the list of saved games
[*]list of saved games should now be properly sorted by date
[/olist]

Quests/Dialogs
[olist]
[*]fixed a bug when some dialogs would suddenly stop
[*]fixed a bug when talking to someone would freeze Jack in place
[*]Vasily now asks for 6 scrap
[*]you should no longer be able to talk about Molly with Zak after you finish the quest
[*]you should no longer be able to give meat to Juggo multiple times
[/olist]

Other
[olist]
[*]Jack's head should no longer spin when you start controlling a bug
[*]various typos fixed.
[/olist]

We strongly recommend you to start a new game. You might try loading an old save, though we cannot guarantee that you won't encounter odd bugs, as in this hotfix update we were concentrating on fixing issues, not backward compatibility. In future updates we will try to make it possible to load up an old saves without major errors.

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Some of you may have noticed that we've already pushed a couple of updates but didn't yet announce what exactly went into those updates. The following list should give you an idea.

The list of changes includes but not limited to:
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug with Vasily's dialog, where if you chose the wrong option at the start would result in him skipping the introduction and not starting his quest. This is fixed for new games and those of you who didn't talk to Vasily yet. If you load an old game, you could hit ~ and type in the console startquest vasily_tools
[*]The scanner should no longer highlight empty containers
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't overwrite a savegame
[*]Hitting Save button without selecting any save and without typing anything now saves into a "default" slot
[*]Fixed the problem where saving after finishing a certain quest would result in game crashing before loading main menu.
[*]The hungry slaves now want fried meat and their dialog (and quest journal entries) reflect that.
[*]Fixed a bug where while typing in the save game name, the main character would quietly react to some of the keys pressed.
[*]Fixed a bug where Zak's arphant would be stuck if saved when it's running to Zak.
[*]Stone Heads Trader now has a proper dialog.
[*]Added collisions to antigravium crystals.
[*]Various typos fixed.
[/olist]
While we recommend to start a new game, in theory loading up an old one might just work.
